purpose: finite external reference evidence; not a proof of the best move or an evaluation bug

selection_policy.earliest: earliest cp gap >=100 with best cp >=-300, or best nonlosing to forced losing mate
selection_policy.nonlosing_for_mate_transition: best cp >=0 or best mate >0; forced mate <0; no bound scores
selection_policy.largest: largest finite cp gap with best cp >=-300; if none, largest finite gap as fallback
selection_policy.no_finite_fallback: fail rather than invent a position or convert mate to cp

limits_note: Only fixed node budgets; no move time or depth limit. Actual reported nodes may overshoot. Engine communication timeout is 600 seconds.
table_policy: Clear Hash before every query and a fresh python-chess game object per query
score_bounds_policy: cp/mate and bounds come from the same last primary score-bearing raw info event; accumulated python-chess bounds are replaced after score equality validation
